0022600192.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (6-2, 4-0 at home, on a two-game winning streak) host the Washington Wizards (4-5, on a two-game losing streak) with the Thunder 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, and 4th in the West, while Washington sits 8th in the East and 1.5 games back in the Southeast. The Thunder are without Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Jaylin Williams (back, spasms), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), and the Wizards are without Anthony Davis (ankle, sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Thunder won both meetings in 2025-26, including a 132-111 win in Washington on March 21, 2026.
